strategy.thesis: Self-described most active pre-seed fund in the Pacific Northwest; invests in SaaS 3.0 (vertical AI agents), Gen AI 2.0 (horizontal AI/infrastructure) and Frontier AI (AI applied to the physical world).

summary.en: Ascend is a Seattle-based pre-seed venture firm founded in 2019 by Kirby Winfield, billed as the most active pre-seed fund in the Pacific Northwest. It raised a $15M Fund I (2019) and $25M Fund II (2023), writing $250K–$750K checks into applied-AI and SaaS startups; Winfield has backed 70+ PNW startups.
